paragraphs.text: Seeing opens with nothing needed and nothing blocking. No helper wanted for finding You, no bar to sight — yet by You alone all is flooded. How then, even now, are You still unseen? From thing-throng, sense-heap, thought’s middle even: the ever self-arising may I full-behold, world-doffed. How be things born, how walk Your seeing-road — inlaid with what great nature-limb? Rising and rising, from land, water, grass on, You scatter creation’s trickle-nectar-floods over all. Faced with Your form-nectar, sated: thirst uprooted, heady, they roam to taste. Not then, not ever, not once even: where no time-thought be, that, this Your seeing is — nor told eternal, nor else. Mind risen to see You: be this much my yoga-ripe, ever: that by bare resolve I enter Your nectar-house, to worship You. Mind-blown by winning Your doubt-free seeing: great souls’ sport stainless deeds and words, lightly, plain. Dwelling between Your feet, within indeed, fearless: on being-grounds those and those may I worship the Lord, unbolted in deed.

Then dwelling deepens. In Your foot-lotus’s belly dissolved, melted of other-longing: honey-overmuch, sated, may I roam at will. Whose resolve to worship You rose from sham even: for him needs must dawn Your fit nearness. Lord: mind past others-hoping, one-sapped utterly — the easy, all-outlying Lord to sating may I drink. What am I? By You unmade: all where You are not, leave it. You-made: take it up. This, the pith-gist. Your in-dwelling thing-born, worshiped as chief by coming-forth: outside You, mere unbeing — how, Ruler, could it be, or be worshiped? Soundless, doubtless, distractionless, ever. In churn even, face to face: Three-eyed, You alone, everywhere. Show Your seat, God, where You are ever Goddess-joined. Foot-dust-ranked with the Lord, why seem slaves unbelief’s ground? Come to seeing’s road, yet You slip: whence from me, my Ruler, Your slave? Not a wink here are You not each breather’s sight-object. By oneness-knowing-nectar’s clear unbroken current: when, All? From the flood, past it, undifference fetching: Thee and my own frame may I win, glad. I, from the fenced-off world, from Your realization-pith: a grain even of world-groundedness befall me, whereby worshiped by You may I be.

Then beholding sealed. Measureless-shaped, thing and thing, wink by wink beholding: Thee alone, world-shaped, my own Lord, may I well behold. Gone to Your limbs: why roams mind after liked thing for thing? Nature unwronged, and my wish filled wholly supreme. Hundreds, they say, by Your might, Lord: who with this very eye, even plough-gaited roaming, full-behold Your body ever before. No thought rises unmade of Your will; fair ever, or else, by the Lord so tis wrought. So Yours-natured, earth-roaming as may be, standing ever at Your unstopped stainless-foot-feast. Mid Your deep sayings may insight rise for me full, first; then wrought power too, and Your-worship-passion unpausing. On dealing-ground even, ever, may this thing-heap dawn for me as Your limb — not as self-worthy come. Mind by own sap roaming where-go: I in its ranges, strayed even, unswerving still, Your-tending-skilled may I ever be. Lord, by Your will alone Your slave am I born: no other’s force here. How then Your face-orb see I never? Strange, this. The keen toward You who behold You from counter-stance: ah, what has drawn near them, what practice fruited? Things be as things by Your being, for me. So be naught elsewise: naught but Thine. What is naught at all, be naught at all; something at all, be something indeed for me. In all ways be: thereby You everywhere are won-and-worshiped.
